run_count_discrepancy_resolution.explanation_of_stage1_error: Stage-1 Notebook 02 scheduled 3*5=15 interpolated SC-CFG=1.0 runs plus 2*3=6 top-up runs on seeds 103..105 for existing cells (21 total), while the plan text miscounted 15+3=18 and the overview table miswrote 16. More fundamentally, reusing calibration seeds 101..105 for confirmatory TOST violates calibration/confirmatory separation (Rule 5).
run_count_discrepancy_resolution.correct_confirmatory_design_breakdown: 3 matched pairs x 2 arms/pair x 5 fresh held-out confirmatory seeds (seeds 201..205) = 30 runs (or 25 runs if two pairs share a target anchor, 30 runs for 3 completely disjoint target anchors).

n2_seed_limitation_audit.consequence: With n=2 seeds per cell, within-cell sample variance s_ij^2 has only df=1 (Chi-square_1), giving a coefficient of variation of sqrt(2)=141.4% for cell-level variance estimates and causing cell-wise Levene tests to become degenerate. Balanced n=5 seeds/cell (as in ELF-M, df_resid=16) reduces cell variance SE by 2x and stabilizes HC3 inference.

sampling_unit_audit.stage1_audit_finding: Stage-1 pooled 5 Task-1 (1200-char) bundles with 15 Task-2 (350-char) bundles into n=20 bundles and treated them as independent replications. In reality, all 100 passages per arm on disk were sampled from seed0 alone (n_seed=1), so within-seed bundle tests measure within-seed0 passage variation rather than cross-seed replication.

hypothesis_verdict.Option_A_higher_sc_increases_semantic_di: FALSIFIED (T5-Small cosine distance and Vendi Score decrease under high SC-CFG across all 3 pairs).
hypothesis_verdict.Option_B_lexical_increases_semantic_inva: UNSUPPORTED (Stage-1 claimed Option B by misinterpreting p > 0.05 as proof of invariance; in fact, T5-Small shows a negative effect g = -0.60 to -0.77 while TF-IDF/LSA shows near-zero or slight positive shift, and CIs are wide).
hypothesis_verdict.Option_C_higher_sc_reduces_semantic_dive: PARTIALLY SUPPORTED on contextual T5-Small embeddings within seed0 (consistent negative point estimates across all 3 pairs, raw p=0.018 on Refined-1), plus higher within-passage half-to-half semantic redundancy on T5, but NOT supported on bag-of-content-words TF-IDF/LSA.
hypothesis_verdict.Option_D_representation_dependent: SUPPORTED: Contextual neural sequence encoders (T5-Small, which attend to phrase structure and repetition) register lower inter-passage distance and higher within-passage redundancy under high SC-CFG, whereas bag-of-words TF-IDF/LSA (which strip word order and repeated function phrases) show near-zero change.
hypothesis_verdict.Option_E_existing_data_insufficient_at_s: SUPPORTED: Because human_eval_blinded_sheet.csv sampled only seed0 (n_seed=1 per arm, 100 truncated passages), seed-level inference (n=5 independent seeds x 1000 full-length passages) requires running Notebook 10 on the full multi-seed samples.jsonl files in Colab.

phase6_human_eval.critical_design_fix: Existing human_eval_blinded_sheet.csv drew all 75 Task-1 pairs and 45 Task-2 bundles from seed0 only and used calibration seeds. The Stage-2 protocol stratifies sampling equally across all 5 confirmatory seeds (seeds 201..205: 5 single pairs/seed and 3 bundles/seed per matched pair) and uses Ordinal CLMM (1-5 Likert) + Logistic GLMM (pairwise preference with random intercepts for seed, stimulus, and rater).

phase8_compute.terminology_verdict: Use 'equal neural function-evaluation count (NFE = K+1 transformer forward passes)' rather than unqualified 'equal compute budget': while SC-CFG is a scalar fill having zero additional tensor ops, gamma > 0 invokes a normal RNG draw (torch.randn_like) and 3 elementwise tensor additions/multiplications per step compared to gamma = 0.

operation_breakdown_per_batch.transformer_forward_passes: K + 1 (K Euler-Maruyama loop steps + 1 terminal clean projection at t=1.0)
operation_breakdown_per_batch.encoder_evaluations: 0 during unconditional generation (used only during training/prompt encoding)
operation_breakdown_per_batch.decoder_lm_head_projections: 1 per sequence (applied once to final x_pred at t=1.0 via model.lm_head)
operation_breakdown_per_batch.sc_cfg_overhead_ops: 0 extra FLOPs: torch.full((B, 4), sc_cfg) writes 4 prefix guidance tokens ALWAYS present in the input sequence (seq_len + 4) for every sc_cfg >= 0.
operation_breakdown_per_batch.gamma_gt_0_vs_gamma_eq_0_overhead_ops: At gamma > 0, each of the K steps executes 1 Gaussian RNG draw (torch.randn_like of shape [B, L, d]) plus 3 elementwise tensor ops for cur_gamma, alpha_bar, and the SDE drift/diffusion update.
